data: Is the black circle at 20% on the 'naive distance' plot lower than the orange circle at 20% on the same plot?

The black circle at 20% on the 'naive distance' plot is higher than the orange circle at 20% on the same plot. The black circle represents the mean naive distance for non-risk-assessed conversations, while the orange circle represents the mean naive distance for risk-assessed conversations. The black circle is positioned above the orange circle at the 20% mark on the x-axis.
